name: Crunchyroll importer
summary: Turn a Crunchyroll season into ComicK episodes.

scripts.title: Format episodes
scripts.summary: Reads data/input.json and writes data/output.txt plus preview images. Edit the episode types in output.txt before uploading.

scripts.title: Upload to ComicK
scripts.summary: Sends data/output.txt to an anime. Episodes already on ComicK are skipped and listed.
